model: emittable: A:=rot(const) [reset] or A:=crazy(A,const), fixed 5-const bank
why: rot-load only offers rot(each of 5 consts); crazy only against the same 5. Lutter reaches all bytes by using assembly-time-computed constants (e.g. 'e'<<1, C2!'H', C2!('l'!C1!C1)) materialized by gen_init, not the 5 bare constants.
